visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with a buzz cut and black t-shirt sits in a well-lit room with shelves full of instant noodle cups and snacks behind him. He gestures animatedly with his hands while looking toward an off-screen companion. (2) The camera switches to a medium shot of an older man with glasses and a grey polo shirt with red and green collar accents. He is being interviewed, nodding and speaking calmly. A yellow flag with a logo on a stick is held in the frame by the first man. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up graphic of a circular beverage cup lid featuring two cartoon characters in green hats and various check boxes for drink types like 'Black Tea' and 'Milk Tea'. (4) Another graphic shows a different lid design with children holding hands around a globe under the text 'I love the Earth'. (5) The visual shifts to an industrial factory setting where large-scale white machinery and massive rolls of plastic film are seen operating under bright, cool-toned indoor lighting. (6) Returning to the interview, both men are seen in a medium full shot. The younger man is laughing and holding the yellow flag high as the older man smiles warmly toward the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Investigation -> Explanation -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to uncover the history and production process behind the jokes found on beverage cup lids in Taiwan. It uses an interview format at a professional printing factory (Jinshan Art Printing) to provide educational insights into how these jokes and designs are conceptualized and manufactured, concluding with a request for viewer interaction.
